items.quote: And when Moses saw that the people were naked;
items.claim: Moses saw that the people were naked.

items.quote: for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:
items.claim: The text blames Aaron for the people's nakedness, which shamed them in front of their enemies.
items.mechanism: Aaron's leadership left the people exposed and shamed in front of their enemies

items.quote: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me.
items.claim: Moses stood in the gate of the camp and called on whoever was on the LORD's side to come to him.
items.action: stood in the gate and called for allegiance

items.quote: And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
items.claim: All the sons of Levi answered Moses's call and gathered around him.
